problems.d: For each salesperson (employee_id in orders) compute total revenue and their position using RANK() from highest to lowest. Columns: name, total, position. Order by position.
problems.s:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(l.quantity * p.price) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
  GROUP BY o.employee_id
)
SELECT e.name, f.total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.total DESC) AS position
FROM f
JOIN employees e ON e.id = f.employee_id
ORDER BY position

problems.d: Revenue per month (format YYYY-MM) and its running total. Columns: month, total, running_total. Order by month.
problems.s:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(l.quantity * p.price) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, total, SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total
FROM m
ORDER BY month

problems.d: Name of customers who have orders but none of them includes products from the Hardware category.
problems.s:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND p.category = 'Hardware'
  )

FROM (
  SELECT home_id AS team_id,
         CASE WHEN home_goals > away_goals THEN 3 WHEN home_goals = away_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pts
  FROM matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_id,
         CASE WHEN away_goals > home_goals THEN 3 WHEN away_goals = home_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

) r
JOIN teams t ON t.id = r.team_id
GROUP BY t.id

  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.id, c.depth + 1 FROM users u JOIN chain c ON u.referrer_id = c.id
)

FROM chain

problems.s:
WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, depth) AS (
  SELECT id, 0 FROM users WHERE id = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT u.id, c.depth + 1 FROM users u JOIN chain c ON u.referrer_id = c.id
)
SELECT u.name, c.depth
FROM chain c
JOIN users u ON u.id = c.id
WHERE c.depth > 0
